name: Transport and Telecommunication Institute
summary: Applied university in Riga with seven bachelor's in English or Latvian: IT, electronics, robotics, aviation, logistics and business.

ib.text: No IB-specific page: EU applicants send the secondary certificate and transcript (checked by the Academic Information Centre) and show English B2 by a test or EU school certificate; EU citizens sit no entrance test.

lastYear.text: Latvia, EU, EEA: apply until 30 September

programmes.name: Computer Science
programmes.credential: BSc Natural Sciences in Computer Science
programmes.about: Computer science foundations with AI built into the teaching, a software-engineering specialisation, and a choice of English or Latvian; also available part-time and blended.
programmes.selectionNote: Diploma, transcript and English B2 proof, then an online motivation interview for foreign applicants; Latvian-schooled ranked on exam averages. 2026 rules; 2027 not yet published.

separateFrom.name: Computer Science: AI Double Degree
separateFrom.reason: A separate English-only double degree with UWE Bristol at a higher fee, with its own page.

programmes.name: Computer Science: AI Double Degree
programmes.credential: TSI BSc + UWE Bristol BSc (Hons) double degree
programmes.about: Four-year double degree with UWE Bristol in the UK, taught in English, with an artificial intelligence specialisation for building and evaluating AI-based software solutions.
programmes.selectionNote: Diploma, transcript and English B2 proof, then an online motivation interview for foreign applicants; Latvian-schooled ranked on exam averages. 2026 rules; 2027 not yet published.

separateFrom.name: Computer Science
separateFrom.reason: The standard TSI degree at a lower fee, in English or Latvian; this one adds a UK degree from UWE Bristol.

programmes.name: Computer Engineering and Electronics
programmes.about: Industrial electronics, embedded systems, computer networks and telecommunications, with specialisations in embedded electronics, industrial electronics or telecommunication systems and computer networks.
programmes.selectionNote: Diploma, transcript and English B2 proof, then an online motivation interview for foreign applicants; Latvian-schooled ranked on exam averages. 2026 rules; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Robotics
programmes.about: Automation and robotics from industrial robots to autonomous systems, including robot programming, control and integration on advanced robotic platforms.
programmes.selectionNote: Diploma, transcript and English B2 proof, then an online motivation interview for foreign applicants; Latvian-schooled ranked on exam averages. 2026 rules; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Transport and Logistics
programmes.about: Transport systems, smart logistics and business analytics for running data-driven international supply chains, with specialisations in sustainable transport or smart logistics; qualification Logistics Manager.
programmes.selectionNote: Diploma, transcript and English B2 proof, then an online motivation interview for foreign applicants; Latvian-schooled ranked on exam averages. 2026 rules; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Aviation Engineering
programmes.about: Aerodynamics, propulsion, avionics, maintenance and airworthiness management, with hands-on training and industry experience; a choice of mechanics or avionics specialisation.
programmes.selectionNote: Diploma, transcript and English B2 proof, then an online motivation interview for foreign applicants; Latvian-schooled ranked on exam averages. 2026 rules; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Business and Management
programmes.about: Management, economics, marketing, finance and entrepreneurship, building analytical and leadership skills for companies and start-ups, with an artificial intelligence specialisation.
programmes.selectionNote: Diploma, transcript and English B2 proof, then an online motivation interview for foreign applicants; Latvian-schooled ranked on exam averages. 2026 rules; 2027 not yet published.

notes: Each programme page shows two full-time prices: the lower one for EU and Ukrainian citizens and a higher one for other nationalities (3,900 euro on most programmes).
The registration fee is 100 euro for EU and EEA applicants with foreign schooling, against 300 euro for applicants from other countries.
Entrance tests and a recorded online interview are set for applicants from outside the EU, EEA and Switzerland, not for EU citizens.
